$comment: Blind rater raterAF. Read only eval/RATING.md, docs/FUN_EVAL_IDLE.md, ../eval-fun/docs/FRAMEWORK.md §1–3 and the template. Played headed on the GPU via tools/driver.mjs (400×800, 3×). Notes: scratchpad/raterAF/notes.md. Seed note: opened ?seed=1702&fresh=1 without dev=1 on the production build; the morgue reports lineage seed 1659016380, so the pinned seed may not have applied.

absences: 8h simulated via ?dev=1&absent=8h after 36 min active cold; 17 min played on return

criterion.delayedRecall: same-day: Heir 4 went down with my freshly written 'foe: boss → attack boss' row and a bank row I had moved up to 30% after the Goblin Warlord had cornered the previous heir at 1 hp with $313 on him. On D8 the Warlord rallied his goblins, the screen shouted 'R5 · attack boss', then 'WARLORD BREAKS' and 'GOBLIN WARLORD DOWN'. He walked into the Fens on D9, my bank row fired at 30% and he came home with $319: 'Banked $319', new best D9.

probes.clarity: The first death banner read 'JACKAL · D3 · 8 UNKNOWN UNUSED' with a GAP seal, and the trace showed him exploring at 1 hp; I knew at once he had died holding 8 potions he never drank.
probes.decisions: Moving the bank threshold showed the choice as numbers: 25% gave 'bank 70% ~$87', 30% gave 'bank 84% ~$95', 40% gave 'bank 95% ~$72' with D6 dropping to 11%; I chose 30% and would again.
probes.mastery: In the first hour I learned that row order matters ('R2 drink unknown' above my return row killed heir 2 with poison) and that banking at 25% is too late when 'R2 no way ← foes hold the way'.
probes.tension: On D8 the ticker read 'carry $313 · bank keeps $313 · death $0 · bank at 25%' while the Warlord rallied, and I was watching his hp, not the screen.
probes.feel: Big pixel callouts over the map ('R5 ATTACK JACKAL', 'BLADES!', 'WARLORD BREAKS') land at the moment a row fires, but one watch froze on a square-tile placeholder after 'WebGL context could not be created' until I reloaded.
probes.surprise: Thog, the jackal 'gone wild' from my very first run, turned up as my tamed pet in the last hour ('jackal Thog fell · jackal Drul fell · jackal Krusk fell').
probes.expression: My set ended as 'shield bash the heavy under 40%, heal, bank at 30%, gas card, attack boss, attack thief, tame weak pack, attack' — mine, but tuned toward whatever the forecast number said.
probes.story: The reel wrote the overnight like a chronicle: 'Warlord cornered him to 4 HP; R5 attacked him; died to Warlord.' / 'The lock took him to 6 HP; R3 banked; banked $215.'
probes.pacing: In 'fast' a run took 49–95 s and felt right; in 'fights' a run took 2.5–3.5 min, and the first 60 s were mostly 'pick up ×6' lines on D1–3.
probes.failure: The morgue said 'slain by ogre · blow 6 · 6 hp short' and listed 'The pearly one: strength. The clear one: fire. The red one: poison.' under my R2 drink unknown; the patch offered was to delete that row.
probes.social: Weight 0; the pets (Thog, Drul, Krusk) are closer to story than relationship.
probes.autonomy: Before the last hour I chose between a push set ('D12 ×2 18% · death 26% · ~$136') and a safe set ('death 9% · ~$143'), and tried a ranger nobody asked me to (it lost me 60% of runs).
probes.progression: Rows went 4 → 8, classes rogue and ranger opened, cards, supplies 3 → 5, party and hatch, a ledger with SEEN/KNOWN/STUDIED/TAMED/BRED columns; but after the absence I had $1745 and each run netted about $0 ('+$91 banked · +$26 salvage · −$120 spent').
probes.aesthetic: The torn red banner with a wax 'ROW' seal, the painted heroes on the stairs and the pixel dungeon look like one game; audio unassessed (I cannot hear; __audio logged 'rule', 'hit', 'slay' cues).
probes.return: I came back to '16 RUNS · D13 DEEPEST · 11 BANKED · 5 DEATHS', a reel, new foes learned ('bloat mother · boss · gas · counter: throw fire') and 'PENDING R4 fired 0 of 16 runs: hp < 30% → drink unknown', and I rewrote that row first.
probes.attribution: Report lines said 'R2 return saved him.' and 'R3 bank saved him.', and the banners named my rows ('OGRE · D6 · R2 DRINK UNKNOWN'); I say 'my bank row killed him' without thinking.

axes.proxy: time-to-first-rule-edit; misread rate on the trace
axes.note: "JACKAL · D3 · 8 UNKNOWN UNUSED" + trace at hp 1; the forecast re-prices every edit in ~3 s. Lapse: the trace only explains the final tick — on the $803 D13 death I could not see why 'hp<30% → bank' did not fire during six ticks at 9/42; and the ranger failed (death 60%) with no hint why.

Bank at 25/30/40% = ~$87/$95/$72 with depth trading off; push vs safe set near-equal EV. Lapse: 'return' is strictly dominated by 'bank' (same odds, ~$70 vs ~$124), and I paid ◆3 for 'card: thief guard' that raised death 10% → 22% — the forecast only told me after the purchase.

Hour one taught order ('drink unknown' above 'return' = poison death), bank earlier ('R2 no way'), and the corridor↔boss stall. After the absence my edits were hill-climbing the forecast number by ±$10; skill stopped being visible.
'carry $313 · death $0 · bank at 25%' on D8 before the Warlord, and 'carry $289 · stalling' — real sweat in the cold hour. On return each run netted ≈ $0 against a $1745 purse, so stakes went flat.

axes.proxy: frame time; events per minute at 1x
axes.note: Callouts 'R5 ATTACK JACKAL', 'BLADES!', 'WARLORD BREAKS', name plates and hp bars read well at 3×. Lapse: one watch froze after WebGL context loss (placeholder squares, 4 min without progress until reload). Audio unassessed.

axes.proxy: death-cause entropy; distinct situations per run
axes.note: Named den jackals (Thog, Krul) recurring and finally tamed; bloat mother gas; the Fens; 'blades!' swarms. Lapse: D1–5 repeat the same beats every run (shrine 'Pray, at a price', cage 'three inside, one to take', monkey steals something).
My set had a shape (tame weak pack, shield bash heavies, bank at 30%). But every choice converged on whatever the forecast priced highest, and cards auto-inserted as bundled rows I did not write.
Thog 'gone wild' on run 1 → my pet → 'jackal Thog fell'; 'Warlord cornered him to 4 HP; R5 attacked him; died to Warlord.' Lapse: most reels were five lines ending 'Banked $88.' with no turn.

axes.proxy: run length; check-in length; dead time at 1x
axes.note: In-run: 'fast' 49–95 s is right; 'fights' 2.5–3.5 min with ~60 s of 'pick up ×N' on D1–3. Check-in: the return report is a very long scroll (FOUND/SALVAGED/STOLEN lists) before the two lines that matter (PENDING, REEL). Cadence: overnight is clearly distinct from a single run.

axes.proxy: share of deaths with a matched-rule trace
axes.note: Banner + seal (ROW/GAP/STALL) + per-row reasons ('R1 no item · R2 no way · R3 no unknown · R4 no path') + morgue '6 hp short' + scored patches. Lapse: a stall ('R4 corridor ↔ R5 hit') took all $289 and the repeat charge ('repeat −$80'), and the D13 trace hid why bank never fired.
Push-for-bounty vs safe, try a class, tame and hatch pets, which unlock to buy. Goals beyond 'bank more / go deeper' were not mine to set.

Within-run: kit from cages, pets, levels (fighter L4). Persistent: rows 4→8, rogue/ranger, cards, supplies 3→5, party/hatch, ledger, trophies, ★6. Automation: repeat loadout, auto cards. Lapse: gold stopped meaning anything after the absence ($1745, runs net ≈ $0).

Painted key art, wax-seal banners, a readable pixel dungeon; the ranger portrait swaps. Lapse: the square-tile placeholder after WebGL loss, and a 'goblin' plate overlapping the ticker. Audio unassessed.

axes.proxy: offline yield vs active; decisions pending on return
axes.note: '16 RUNS · D13 · 11 BANKED · 5 DEATHS', a reel with rows named, new foes with counters, and 'PENDING R4 fired 0 of 16 runs' — I edited within a minute. Lapse: the edits I made on return barely moved outcomes (net ≈ $0 per run), and the wall of FOUND/SALVAGED lines buries the decision.

axes.proxy: share of deaths attributable to a rule the player wrote
axes.note: 'R2 return saved him.', 'R3 bank saved him.', 'OGRE · D6 · R2 DRINK UNKNOWN', 'PINK JELLY · D9 · R3 BANK' — I narrate in first person. Lapse: overnight deaths where 'bank' could not fire ('no way') felt like the dungeon's decision, not mine.
